finding_key: packages/notes/src/view/list-empty-bullet-plugin.ts::fix is broader than issue #517: single-dash setext headings are disabled everywhere, not just inside lists
evidence:
The `isLoneDash` guard in `lheadingRule` (list-empty-bullet-plugin.ts:~105-110) is unconditional — it does not consult `state.blkIndent`, `state.parentType`, or any list context — so any single-`-` setext underline is rejected everywhere, top level and in blockquotes included. `isEmptyBulletLine` likewise only requires `sCount[line] >= blkIndent`, and `wrappedList` only requires `silent && state.parentType === 'paragraph'`, so a top-level `Heading\n-` now terminates the paragraph and yields `

Heading

` instead of the standard CommonMark `

Heading

`. The claim's secondary point also checks out: the only setext regression test is `'Heading\n---'` (preview.test.ts, "preserves multi-dash setext headings"), and the plugin's own TODO doc listed a "top-level lone dash" test that was never added. The deviation is documented as intentional in notes.md, so this is a scope/design-fit concern rather than an outright bug, and single-dash setext headings are uncommon relative to `---`, hence minor.
